props.ariaLabel: Show current or draft Blueprint JSON
Show current or draft Blueprint preview

blueprint-preview-content.visibility: studio.activeTab = 'preview' and studio.blueprintPreviewVersion = 'current' and studio.selected.artifact != null

blueprint-preview-context-form.visibility: studio.activeTab = 'preview' and studio.blueprintPreviewVersion = 'current' and studio.previewContextFormSpec != null

blueprint-draft-preview-content.visibility: studio.activeTab = 'preview' and studio.blueprintPreviewVersion = 'draft' and studio.selected.draft != null

fields.expression: {'properties':{'cloneFrom':{'title':'Clone from','type':'string','enum':$append([''], studio.blueprints[source = 'repo' or published = true].id),'enumNames':$append(['Blank Blueprint'], studio.blueprints[source = 'repo' or published = true].(label & ' · ' & version)),'span':12},'id':{'title':'New Blueprint ID','type':'string','pattern':'^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9._\\/\\-]*[a-z0-9])?$','span':12},'kind':{'title':'Kind','type':'string','span':12},'version':{'title':'Initial version','type':'string','span':12}},'required':['id','kind','version'],'additionalProperties':false}

compute.expression:
($bp := sources.`fetch-blueprint`; $bp.artifact ? '# ' & $bp.id & '

- **Version:** ' & $bp.version & '
- **Kind:** ' & $bp.kind & '
- **Source:** ' & ($bp.readonly ? 'Repository bootstrap' : 'User workspace') & '
- **Tiers:** ' & $join($bp.artifact.payload.tiers.id, ', ') & '
- **Recipes:** ' & $string($count($bp.artifact.payload.recipes)) : $bp ? '# ' & $bp.id & '

Draft only; promote the draft to create the first published version.' : '')
